hook: What if 17,700 m³/s of water flooded the Brazil‑Argentina border?

sections.voiceover: What if 17,700 m³/s of water flooded the Brazil‑Argentina border?
On 23 Oct 2026 the Iguazú River reached 17,700 m³/s at the falls, twelve times average. How does that surge affect the Brazil‑Argentina border?
But it marked the 11th extreme flood event recorded in 2026.
The surge flooded border lowlands, covering trails and roads. Flow peaked at 17,700 m³/s, six times normal, straining generation.
17,700 m³/s reshaped the Brazil‑Argentina border in 2026.
